courses.title: Embodying Golden Human - Ascension Mentorship (6-month)
courses.description: A six-month private mentorship with six 90-minute sessions, channelled guidance, supplementary materials, recordings and six months of Telegram support. It is aimed at people who want to work closely with Ariel on their spiritual development, light language and soul gifts. Entry is by application, followed by a free 30-minute consultation call.

courses.title: Metamorphosis: Your Transformation Portal (4-month)
courses.description: A four-month private mentorship for people in a big life transition between their late thirties and early fifties. It draws on astrology (Uranus and Saturn oppositions, the Chiron return) alongside spiritual teaching and practical guidance. It includes eight 75-minute sessions, pre-work, recordings and four months of Telegram support.

courses.title: Light Language & Soul Voice Activation Mini Mentorship
courses.description: A two-month private mentorship of four online sessions focused on the voice, sound and light language. Sessions cover using sound with intention, clearing old patterns around self-expression, and building daily practices that support channelling. Ariel can also help students choose sound instruments such as singing bowls or drums.

courses.title: Venus & Moon: A Sacred Feminine Immersive Experience
courses.description: A one-day women's retreat in Dubai, co-hosted by Ariel Tang and EFT practitioner Libby Salord at a private residence in Jumeirah 1. The day includes a sisterhood circle, yin yoga and embodiment practices, EFT tapping, a blue lotus tea ceremony with channelling, and a closing sound bath. Lunch and welcome gifts are included.

free_resources.title: Becoming Light Free Ascension Masterclass
free_resources.description: A recorded three-hour masterclass in two parts, free with an email sign-up. Ariel tells the story of her own spiritual path, including her Reiki practice and channelled encounters, and weaves in guidance and energy work. It is a good introduction to how she teaches.

free_resources.title: Free Avalon Glastonbury Spiritual Travel Guide & Sample Itinerary
free_resources.description: A free travel guide to Glastonbury and Avalon in England, with a sample itinerary for visiting its sacred sites. It is delivered by email after sign-up.
